:::{#exr-rss-deriv-intercept}
#### Derivative of RSS with respect to the intercept

Find the partial derivative of the simple linear regression
residual sum of squares $\text{RSS}(\intcoef, \coef{x})$ (@exm-rss-slr)
with respect to the intercept, $\partial \text{RSS} / \partial \intcoef$,
and write it in terms of $\bar{x}$ and $\bar{y}$.
:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-rss-deriv-intercept}

Differentiate one operation at a time,
starting from the definition (@exm-rss-slr):

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef}
&= \frac{\partial}{\partial \intcoef} \sumin (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)^2
&& \text{(definition of RSS)}\\
&= \sumin \frac{\partial}{\partial \intcoef} (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)^2
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= \sumin 2 (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
  \frac{\partial}{\partial \intcoef} (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
&& \text{(chain rule)}
\end{aligned}
$$

The inner derivative:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial}{\partial \intcoef} (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
&= \frac{\partial y_i}{\partial \intcoef}
  - \frac{\partial \intcoef}{\partial \intcoef}
  - \frac{\partial (\coef{x} x_i)}{\partial \intcoef}
&& \text{(derivative of a sum)}\\
&= 0 - 1 - 0
&& \text{($y_i$ and $\coef{x} x_i$ do not depend on $\intcoef$)}\\
&= -1
\end{aligned}
$$

Plugging the inner derivative back in:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{\partial \text{RSS}}{\partial \intcoef}
&= \sumin 2 (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i) (-1)
&& \text{(inner derivative is $-1$)}\\
&= \sumin -2 (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
&& \text{(multiply $2$ by $-1$)}\\
&= -2 \sumin (y_i - \intcoef - \coef{x} x_i)
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= -2 \paren{\sumin y_i - \sumin \intcoef - \sumin \coef{x} x_i}
&& \text{(split the sum)}\\
&= -2 \paren{\sumin y_i - n \intcoef - \sumin \coef{x} x_i}
&& \text{(sum of a constant)}\\
&= -2 \paren{\sumin y_i - n \intcoef - \coef{x} \sumin x_i}
&& \text{(constant factor out of the sum)}\\
&= -2 \paren{n \bar{y} - n \intcoef - \coef{x} \sumin x_i}
&& \text{($\sumin y_i = n \bar{y}$)}\\
&= -2 \paren{n \bar{y} - n \intcoef - \coef{x} n \bar{x}}
&& \text{($\sumin x_i = n \bar{x}$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
